name: Current default · fast-v2.2 FP16 + bundled ONNX regressor
purpose: Fresh benchmark of the repository's default Step 7 prediction path, using the latest fast-v2.2 held-out split.

protocol.split: test from the split snapshot referenced by the latest PREDICT_CHECKPOINT_PATH training manifest
protocol.measurement: Direct in-process raw photo to waviness score; model startup reported separately.

note: PREDICT_CHECKPOINT_PATH is the PyTorch rollback/evaluation checkpoint. The default fast-v2.2 Step 7 backend loads the bundled ONNX regressor listed above.
